chunks: And indeed it is a sign/knowledge of the Hour, so do not doubt it; and follow Me, this is the straight path.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Dajjal as a sign of the Hour in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a reference to the Prophet Muhammad himself being the 'knowledge of the Hour,' or alternatively to the Dajjal, serving as a pivotal eschatological sign. It urges believers to maintain certainty in the coming of the End Times and to adhere strictly to the straight path (Sirat al-Mustaqim) to navigate the trials associated with this figure.
